findings.title: Child-session cycling includes the parent, so 'next subagent' can land on primary session
findings.rationale: moveChild builds a list of sessions that includes both the parent and all children, then cycles by id. From a child session, pressing 'next child' can navigate to the parent, which shows the primary agent/model.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter out the parent when cycling children (keep parent navigation on session_parent) or make the UI label explicitly say it cycles parent+children.
